p: Praise ye the LORD: The prophet declares that he will praise God both privately and openly, and that from the heart, as he who consecrates himself wholly and only to God.
great: He shows that God's works are a sufficient reason for us to praise him, but chiefly his benefits toward his Church.
meat unto them that fear him: God has given to his people all that was necessary for them and will do so even for his covenant's sake, and in this sense the Hebrew word is taken in Pr 30:8,31:15.
works of his hands are verity: As God proposed to take care of his Church so in effect does he declare himself just and true in the government of the same.
The fear of the LORD is: They only are wise who fear God and none have understanding but they who obey the word.
do his commandments: That is, his commandment as in Ps 111:7.
